description: Defines a data transfer object class 'I18NGroupSearchFilterParams' for filtering search parameters related to internationalization groups within the HRM system. It extends basic filter parameters and specifies allowed sort fields.

classes.name: I18NGroupSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A class that encapsulates filtering options for searching internationalization groups, including sorting capabilities with predefined allowed sort fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to null.
